title: Skimmer Alternatives (2026): 5 Pool Tools With Real Prices
description: Skimmer alternatives for pool routes: Pool Brain, Pool Office Manager, Paythepoolman, UpBuoy and GorillaDesk on published prices, routing and trials.
h1: Skimmer alternatives for pool service companies
body:
Skimmer charges per serviced pool: Getting Started is $1 per serviced location per month (minimum $49/mo) and Scaling Up is $2 per location (minimum $98/mo). Techs and admins are unlimited, months you don't service a pool aren't billed, and route optimization is on Scaling Up (Skimmer pricing, checked 2026-11-10). If per-pool pricing doesn't suit your route, here's what five alternatives publish. Every number comes from the vendor's own pricing page, checked 2026-11-09 or 2026-11-10. Anything a vendor doesn't publish is marked unknown.

{{table:skimmer,pool-brain,pool-office-manager,paythepoolman,upbuoy,gorilladesk}}

The alternatives

  • Pool Brain: priced per tech. One plan with all features: $50/mo base plus $65/mo per active field technician (Pool Brain's own example: 5 techs = $375/mo). Office users are unlimited. Route optimization, drag-and-drop scheduling, and two-way QuickBooks Online sync are included. A free trial is offered, but its length isn't stated. See Skimmer vs Pool Brain.
  • Pool Office Manager: priced per user. $125/mo for the first user and $25/mo for each additional active user (2 users $150, 4 users $200, 10 users $350). You can deactivate users in the off-season. 30-day trial with every feature; you enter a card at signup and aren't charged until day 30. QuickBooks Online two-way sync is a +$25/mo add-on.
  • Paythepoolman: low per-tech price. $50/mo base plus $15/mo per technician (vendor example: 3 techs = $95/mo), with no per-pool charge. Route optimization and GPS tracking are in the base plan. No contract or activation fee, and a 30-day free trial. Card processing rates aren't published, and ACH and Apple/Google Pay need the $25/mo Pool Junction customer app.
  • UpBuoy: per pool, with a free plan. Essential is free for up to 3 locations. Professional is $3 per serviced location per month (minimum $99/mo) and adds route optimization and a visual schedule calendar. No long-term contracts; 30-day money-back guarantee on paid plans.
  • GorillaDesk: priced per route. Basic $49/mo, Pro $99/mo, Growth $149/mo for the first route, with unlimited users. Extra routes are +$50 each on Pro; on Basic they're +$50 for routes 2-3 and +$30 from route 4. Basic routing is capped at 25 stops; Drive Matrix routing is on Pro. 14-day free trial with no credit card.

Monthly cost at three route sizes (list prices)

Worked out from the published formulas above, in USD per month before payment fees and add-ons. We assume one tech or route per 80 serviced pools and one user per tech. Your pools per tech will differ.

Skimmer Scaling Up ($2/pool, $98 min)$160$320$640
Pool Brain ($50 + $65/tech)$115$180$310
Pool Office Manager ($125 + $25/extra user)$125$150$200

UpBuoy Professional ($3/pool, $99 min)$240$480$960
GorillaDesk Basic (per route)$49$99$179
GorillaDesk Pro (per route)$99$149$249

Per-pool pricing (Skimmer, UpBuoy) grows with every pool you add. Per-tech, per-user and per-route pricing (Pool Brain, Pool Office Manager, Paythepoolman, GorillaDesk) grows when you hire. Feature sets differ, so compare route optimization and chemical tools in the table above before you pick on price alone.

Before you switch from Skimmer

Check how each tool handles chemical readings and dosing, whether it syncs with your accounting (most list QuickBooks Online, some as a paid add-on), and how card payments are processed, since several of these don't publish processing rates. Run through the software buying checklist before you move your customer list.

faq: It depends on pools per tech. Using the published formulas for one tech with 80 pools, Paythepoolman is $65/mo, GorillaDesk Basic $49/mo (1 route), Skimmer Getting Started $80/mo, Pool Brain $115/mo and Pool Office Manager $125/mo. UpBuoy has a free plan for up to 3 locations.
Which Skimmer alternatives include route optimization?

Pool Brain and Paythepoolman include it in their single plan. UpBuoy includes it on Professional, and GorillaDesk has Drive Matrix routing on Pro. Pool Office Manager lists route optimization. On Skimmer, route optimization is on Scaling Up.
Which Skimmer alternative has a free plan?
UpBuoy's Essential plan is free for up to 3 locations. The others offer trials: Pool Office Manager and Paythepoolman 30 days, GorillaDesk 14 days, and Pool Brain a free trial of unstated length.
No. Skimmer includes unlimited techs and admins and bills per serviced location, with unserviced months not billed.
